title: Amide-functionalized heterometallic helicate cages as highly efficient catalysts for CO2 conversion under mild conditions

synthesis.procedure: General procedure for complexes 1–2: 27 μL (0.2 mmol) triethylamine was added to a 20 mL CH3CN solution of 0.1 mmol H2L. Then 0.05 mmol Zn(NO3)2·H2O was added and stirred for 15 min to obtain a suspension. To this solution was added 0.067 mmol Ln(NO3)3·6H2O (Ln = Nd3+ for 1) in 5 mL of methanol to obtain a clear solution. The mixture was stirred for 1 h and filtered for crystallization at room temperature. After about 10 days colorless single crystals suitable for crystal analysis were obtained. A related bulk route used mixed acetonitrile–methanol (4 : 1) with six equivalents of H2L, three equivalents of Zn(NO3)2·6H2O, four equivalents of Ln(NO3)3·6H2O and triethylamine; abundant solid for catalysis was obtained by stirring 1 h in a smaller solvent volume.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature crystallization; ligand/metal mixing at ambient conditions after 15 min then 1 h stirring
synthesis.time: stirred 15 min then 1 h; crystallization about 10 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution self-assembly and crystallization from CH3CN/MeOH
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: mixture stirred 1 h and filtered; colorless single crystals obtained after about 10 days at room temperature

synthesis.procedure: Same general procedure as 1 using Eu(NO3)3·6H2O: 27 μL (0.2 mmol) triethylamine was added to a 20 mL CH3CN solution of 0.1 mmol H2L. Then 0.05 mmol Zn(NO3)2·H2O was added and stirred for 15 min. 0.067 mmol Eu(NO3)3·6H2O in 5 mL methanol was added to give a clear solution, stirred 1 h, filtered, and crystallized at room temperature for about 10 days to give colorless single crystals. Complexes 1 and 2 are isostructural.
